sop_modules.name: Setup — Protection
sop_modules.description: Protection setup for foundation repaint. Landscape perimeter protection (LF-based), hardscape walk/patio protection. Ground-level work — no equipment staging needed beyond basic rollers/brushes.

tasks.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy tarps and plastic sheeting along foundation perimeter where landscape is adjacent. RP scope includes scraping debris containment.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths on walkways and patios adjacent to foundation wall.

tasks.name: Equipment and Material Staging
tasks.description: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, materials at foundation. If spray_backroll: configure airless sprayer + stage 18-inch backroll frame. Ground-level — no ladder/scaffold needed.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape protection -> Hardscape protection -> Equipment staging.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment — Visual, Chalk/Adhesion, Moisture, Grade-Line Gap
sop_modules.description: RP-specific 4-point assessment module for foundation. Results drive substrate state assignment, primer selection, and prep intensity. All FIXED time tasks. Includes RP-specific grade-line gap check for incorrect caulking.

tasks.name: Visual Condition Inspection
tasks.description: Walk foundation perimeter. Map cracking, peeling, efflorescence, adhesion failure. Assign substrate state per worst-state-wins. Photograph defects. Foundation is small scope — single pass.

quality_notes.QT3: Full perimeter scan with work light. Document defects. Assign condition scale.

tasks.name: Chalk and Adhesion Test
tasks.description: White cloth chalk rub test on painted foundation surfaces. ASTM D3359 cross-hatch adhesion test on representative areas. Grade chalk severity. Verify coating adhesion.

tasks.name: Moisture Content Testing (MC <= 4% Hard Stop)
tasks.description: Electronic moisture meter checks at multiple points along foundation band. MC > 4% = HARD STOP. Foundation is stricter than masonry wall (12%) due to continuous ground contact. 3-5 readings per elevation. Document all readings.

tasks.name: Grade-Line Gap Assessment (RP-Specific)
tasks.description: Inspect the siding-to-foundation gap (3/8 inch with Z-flashing). Check if previous painter incorrectly caulked the drainage gap. If caulked: flag for caulk removal before painting. NEVER caulk this gap. RP-specific — not present in NC because new construction has clean gap.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Visual condition -> Chalk/adhesion -> Moisture -> Grade-line gap. All FIXED time per project.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation — Efflorescence, Wash, Scrape, Patch
sop_modules.description: Surface preparation for foundation repaint. Efflorescence treatment, pressure wash, scraping/feathering failing paint, crack patching. Condition-driven intensity via FAC_FNRP_CONDITION modifier on prep tasks.

tasks.name: Efflorescence Treatment
tasks.description: Stiff brush removal of efflorescence deposits, TSP wash if moderate. Must remove ALL efflorescence before coating. Foundation is highly susceptible due to ground contact. Conditional — include when efflorescence is present.

tasks.name: Pressure Wash Foundation Surface
tasks.description: Pressure wash (1,500-2,500 PSI) existing painted foundation. Dual purpose: cleaning and paint removal on failing areas. 24-hr dry time before coating. RP allows higher pressure for paint removal on non-sound areas.

quality_notes.QT2: Basic wash to remove dirt. Light pressure on sound areas.
quality_notes.QT3: Thorough wash. Higher pressure on failing areas. TSP for stains.

tasks.transfer_source: MODIFIED from TSK_FNDN_PRESSURE_WASH (added RP paint removal)

tasks.name: Scrape and Feather Failing Paint
tasks.description: Carbide scraper to remove failing/peeling paint. 80-grit feather-edge sanding at transitions. RP-SPECIFIC task — not present in NC. Condition-driven intensity.

tasks.name: Foundation Crack Patching
tasks.description: Patch hairline and minor cracks in foundation wall with hydraulic cement. Cracks wider than 1/4 inch = structural — flag for GC. Same process as NC but may encounter more cracks in RP due to age/settlement.

tasks.name: Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust, scraping debris, and TSP residue from foundation surface before priming. RP-specific — more debris than NC from scraping.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Efflorescence treatment -> Pressure wash (24-hr dry) -> Scrape/feather -> Crack patch -> Dust cleanup. THEN moisture retest before priming.

sop_modules.name: State-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: State-driven primer application for foundation repaint. Chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, alkali-resistant spot prime on exposed bare masonry, acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion.

tasks.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Application
tasks.description: Full surface chalk-binding primer on foundation with SS_EXT_CHALKING state. Roll or brush application. MANDATORY — not quality-optional.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Spot Application on Bare Masonry
tasks.description: Spot prime exposed bare foundation areas where coating has been removed by scraping/washing. pH 12-14 substrate requires alkali-resistant primer. Roll or brush application at failure points.

tasks.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Roll Application
tasks.description: Roll application of acrylic stain-block primer on previously painted foundation. Spot prime for localized failure, full prime for SS_EXT_PEELING.

tasks.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Spray Application
tasks.description: Spray application of acrylic stain-block primer on foundation. For larger scope requiring spray_backroll method.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Alkali-resistant spot prime on bare areas FIRST -> Then full surface prime (chalk-binding OR acrylic stain-block). SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT skips prime.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat Application
sop_modules.description: Finish coat application for foundation repaint. Acrylic or cementitious coating. brush_roll or spray_backroll method. QT2 = 1 coat, QT3 = 2 coats. Flat sheen only.

tasks.name: Acrylic Finish — Roll Application
tasks.description: Roller application of acrylic masonry finish on primed foundation. 3/4-inch nap for poured, 1-1/4-inch nap for CMU. Per-coat rate.

tasks.name: Acrylic Finish — Spray Application
tasks.description: Airless spray of acrylic masonry finish on primed foundation. spray_backroll method — backroll on CMU. Per-coat rate.

tasks.name: Cementitious Coating (Drylok-type) — Roll Application
tasks.description: Roller application of cementitious coating on primed foundation. Heavier body, thicker application, lower coverage. Per-coat rate.

tasks.name: Cementitious Coating (Drylok-type) — Brush Application
tasks.description: Brush application of cementitious coating on foundation. Detail work and small areas. Per-coat rate.

tasks.name: Detail Brush Work (Pipes, Vents, Transitions)
tasks.description: Detail brush work around foundation penetrations and at siding-to-foundation transition. MASK the grade-line gap — NEVER caulk. Per-coat rate.

tasks.name: Backroll After Spray (CMU Foundation)
tasks.description: Immediate backroll with 18-inch roller after spray application on CMU foundation. Forces coating into porous block surface. spray_backroll method only. CMU only per masonry doctrine.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray/roll field -> Backroll CMU (if spray) -> Detail brush. QT3: repeat for second coat.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup — Inspect, Touch-Up, Teardown, Equipment
sop_modules.description: Final inspection, touch-up, protection teardown, equipment cleaning, and site cleanup for foundation repaint.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Ground-level walkthrough of all foundation elevations. Check for holidays, missed spots, coating uniformity. Verify grade-line gap still clear. Check protection zones for overspray.

tasks.name: Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final inspection. Foundation typically needs minimal touch-up — simple geometry.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove all landscape tarps, hardscape covers, tape, plastic sheeting. Check for tape adhesive residue. Verify no paint on protected surfaces.

tasks.name: Tool and Equipment Cleaning
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, trays, sprayer (if used). Dispose of saturated roller covers.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect and bag scraping debris, paint chips, empty containers. RP-specific — more debris than NC from scraping and old paint removal.

tasks.name: Customer Walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk foundation perimeter with homeowner/GC. Point out completed work, discuss maintenance. RP-specific — occupied home context.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect -> Touch-up -> Protection teardown -> Tool clean -> Site debris -> Customer walkthrough.
